Select the first 1000 rows of assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, and pchembl_value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1075104 (Leucine-rich repeat serine/threonine-protein kinase 2). Filter to exact standard_relation '=' rows with non-null pchembl_value. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary, and require canonical_smiles via an INNER JOIN to compound_structures. Order results by molecule_chembl_id and assay_chembl_id.
